item_short_desc: Rothco’s Orienteering Ranger Type Compass is lightweight for easy travel and features a large easy-to-turn dial, magnifying glass, and ruler graduation to help determine distance.
description: Rothco’s Orienteering Ranger Type Compass is made of lightweight and durable plastic to help last your next outdoor venture. Ruler graduations along the sides used in conjunction with a map’s scale will help determine distances. Featuring a liquid filled luminous pointer, magnifying glass, a transparent base, and a sighting mirror, Rothco’s survival compass is built easy to use and yields accurate results. This ranger compass measures 4 3/4” (7 3/4” Open) X 2 5/8” X 3/4” and has a large easy-to-turn dial.
